_header.labelledBy: Claude (Sonnet 5.5, tdd-guide agent) for the Hirelane Phase 2 engine lane
_header.method: Each snippet was read and labelled by hand BEFORE any parser code existed. No parser output was consulted. Fixture snippets (origin=fixture; 318) are a stratified, md5-ordered sample of the 18,860 postings in packages/ingest/fixtures/full (recorded 2026-10-15), with HTML tags stripped and entities decoded; hand-written cases (origin=hand) cover INR LPA/lakh/crore/CTC, EU grouping, hourly/daily/weekly/monthly, OTE, bare-dollar disambiguation by country and false positives.
_header.expectedShape: null when no base-or-OTE salary is stated; otherwise the FIRST base statement (first OTE statement if no base statement exists) with money in integer minor units at the STATED period. A single amount has minMinor=maxMinor; "up to" has minMinor=null; "from" has maxMinor=null. countries (optional) is the SalaryContext.
